maddeler.e:
نتوارث (form VI)
# نَتَوَارَثُ (natawāraṯu) /na.ta.waː.ra.θu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَوَارَثَ (tawāraṯa)
# نَتَوَارَثَ (natawāraṯa) /na.ta.waː.ra.θa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَوَارَثَ (tawāraṯa)
# نَتَوَارَثْ (natawāraṯ) /na.ta.waː.raθ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَوَارَثَ (tawāraṯa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
